series_break: ARCH-2 -> ARCH-3 is an explicit classification-series break because classification now consumes ESI-2 context/reference/root evidence. CMS-1 remains unchanged.

authority.statement: ARCH-3 classifies ESI-2 symbols deterministically for architecture cleanup/ownership visibility. It never authorizes deletion by itself and cannot weaken build, test, Kodex or runtime gates.

A.label: Loeschbar
A.meaning: A private free function with productive_reachability=NO may be A only when it belongs to a closed unreachable removal component under resolved ESI-2 references. Every resolved incoming reference to every member must originate from a member of the same component; any ambiguous reference or sensitive declaration blocks A.
A.fail_closed: Any reference from outside the component, any ownerless/global resolved reference, any ambiguous reference, sensitive declaration attribute or other missing prerequisite yields no A classification.

B.label: Zusammenfuehrbar / redundant
B.meaning: An explicitly legacy/obsolete/deprecated/shadow-named symbol that is itself still bound by ESI-2 reachability/reference evidence has a deterministic same-file counterpart target that is productively reachable or referenced.
B.fail_closed: No concrete target yields no B classification. ARCH-3 does not manufacture redundancy from naming similarity alone.

C.label: Notwendige Unterstuetzung
C.meaning: A symbol is productively reachable without an ARCH-3 D authority rule, or is explicitly bound test/tool support under the fixed rules.

D.label: Autoritativer Kern
D.meaning: A productively reachable entrypoint or a productively reachable symbol whose own simple name carries explicit Writer/Authorization, Selection, Canonical or Governance validate/verify responsibility matches an ARCH-3 D rule.
D.negative_rule: Module path, file path and enclosing namespace names alone never establish D. ARCH-3 does not yet claim that D.WRITER_AUTHORITY_SYMBOL is the generated ProductiveWritePath surface set; that stronger native binding remains separate future work.

OFFEN.label: Nicht sicher entscheidbar
OFFEN.meaning: No A/B/C/D rule has sufficient static evidence. OFFEN is the mandatory fail-closed default. ESI-2 exposes the reachability and ambiguity diagnostics that explain this state.

removed_legacy_class: N is not part of ARCH-3. Legacy AIC-1 A/B/C/N/OFFEN classifications are not comparable to native ARCH-1/2/3.

comparability.rule: A/B/C/D/OFFEN counts are directly comparable only when architecture_contract_version is identical. ARCH-1, ARCH-2 and ARCH-3 are distinct measurement series.

deletion_boundary: Class A is a static architecture statement inside ESI-2 scope, not a command to mutate source. Actual removal still requires normal EtuSchlopf change control and gates.
